Which one should you buy?

For the best balance of longevity and capacity: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2.

For a system you can expand later: Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 or BLUETTI AC200L.

For spending around $500: BLUETTI AC180.

For the lowest upfront cost: ALLPOWERS P1800.

One important limitation: these are portable power stations, not automatically whole-house backup systems. They can power selected appliances through their outlets, but powering household circuits may require compatible transfer equipment and professional installation. Actual runtime also depends on appliance consumption, startup surges, and conversion losses.

My recommendation: Start with the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 if you mainly want to protect your refrigerator, Wi-Fi, lights, and electronics during outages. Choose an expandable model if you expect your backup needs to grow.
